name: Why is proper subfloor preparation important for bathroom flooring?

mainEntity.name: Why is proper subfloor preparation important for bathroom flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper subfloor preparation is critical for a durable and aesthetically pleasing bathroom floor. The subfloor must be clean, dry, level, and structurally sound. Any moisture, unevenness, or damage can lead to issues like cracking tiles, loose planks, or mold growth. Addressing these issues before installation ensures the new flooring adheres correctly, maintains its integrity, and lasts for its intended lifespan.
acceptedAnswer.description: Proper subfloor preparation ensures durability and appearance by addressing moisture, unevenness, and damage, preventing future flooring issues.
